# Revolutionary Self-Heating Technology.

## We have launched our crowd fundraising offering!

[ Click Here to Learn More! ][17]

### Please Join Us in Our Mission to Revolutionize Ready-to-Drink Beverages!

[HeatGen_Male_Businessman.jpg]

**Your Favorite Beverage. Hot on Demand.**

**With just a simple twist, HeatGen unlocks the comfort of a hot beverage with the convenience
consumers demand.**

The options are endless: your favorite coffee, tea, bone broth, hot chocolate sip-able soups, sake
or cider, hot whenever and wherever you want. HeatGen delivers the premium on-the-go experience that
Millennial and Gen Z consumers need. When our innovation teams up with your brand, revolutionary
things will happen.

[Learn More][18]
 

## **HeatGen works simply, safely, efficiently and reliably within the packaging using a solid-state
## thermal reaction. Our patented technology delivers the solution innovative brands are looking
## for.**

[Powered By HeatGenArtboard 1.png]
 
 

### Fast & Reliable

Heats beverages in less than 2 minutes, and works every time. Simply twist, then hear and feel the
magic as your beverage heats up to a perfect temperature.

[Powered By HeatGenArtboard 4 copy 2.png]
 

### Light & Small

HeatGen heaters are lightweight and displace a minimal amount of beverage (10%), allowing for a
great consumer experience. It’s  a powerful technology in a tiny package. 

[Powered By HeatGenArtboard 3 copy 2.png]
 

### Sustainable

The HeatGen package is made entirely of sustainable and affordable materials.  All HeatGen packaging
is recyclable, both before and after the heater is activated.

[Powered By HeatGenArtboard 13 copy.png]
 

### Safe

HeatGen’s patented Passive Thermal Control (PTC) dissipates heat away from the package if needed to
ensure the heater never exceeds the defined maximum temperature.

[Red Block.png]

Expand Your Brand

With development complete, HeatGen is already in market launches with a number of leading brands.
HeatGen is the first and only self-heating technology to meet innovative brands’ criteria for
success.

[learn more][19]
[Bottom-Woman-Outdoors.jpg]

Consumers Want It.

Our research proves it: Consumers are hot for our self-heating solution. They want the portability,
the convenience and the quick and easy solution it provides.

[Learn More][20]

> “HeatGen’s technology is a breakthrough for both the beverage category and consumers everywhere
> who want to enjoy a hot can of coffee, tea, soup or sake whenever and wherever they please.”

— Walter Robb, former Co-CEO of Whole Foods, HeatGen advisor
 
 
 
[Powered By HeatGen Logo.png]
 
Hours

# Professional Manufacturer of Biodegradable Tableware and Disposable Takeaway Food Packaging!

## Company Profile

[Bioleader Factory Video Shows]
Manufacturing Process Factory Show

**Xiamen Bioleader Environmental Protection Technology Co., Ltd. **is a leading producer of
eco-friendly biodegradable tableware and sustainable takeaway food packaging solutions.

Our main products are:
**① Sugarcane Bagasse Tableware:** bagasse food containers, bagasse clamshell boxes, bagasse bowls,
bagasse plates, trays, cups, cup lids;
**② Cornstarch Tableware:** cornstarch clamshell boxes and cornstarch food containers, cornstarch
plates, cornstarch cups and cornstarch cutlery;
**③ Food Paper Packaging:** [paper cups][85] , paper soup bowls, paper salad bowls, and food paper
boxes.
**④ Biodegradable Compostable Cutlery: ** spoon, fork, knife, spork, and custom individual wrapped
cutlery sets.

We supply a **one-stop disposable biodegradable food packaging solution** with factory-direct
pricing, flexible MOQ, and small-batch customization. Our advanced production facility and excellent
technology ensure a pollution-free production process. We adopt scientific management and strict
quality control to guarantee high-quality, safe, green, and cost-effective products.

## Certifications & Compliance

reports**.

# Custom Food Packaging Manufacturer in China | OEM/ODM Solutions

With over a decade of experience in food-grade packaging production, Dashan specializes in PET,
RPET, PP, PLA, and biodegradable materials that meet FDA, SGS, and EU standards. From eco-friendly
cups to leak-resistant containers, our facility ensures consistent quality, fast global delivery,
and full OEM customization support. Whether you’re launching a new food brand or scaling your
packaging supply chain, Dashan delivers reliability you can count on.

## Our Core Strengths

Dashan delivers food-grade packaging with ISO-certified automation, eco-compliant materials, and
export-ready logistics. We serve 60+ countries with FDA, SGS, and EU-certified PLA, PET, and PP
products — all produced with tight quality control and fast lead times. From production to port, we
ensure every container is safe, scalable, and ready for your global business.

## Launch Your Food Packaging Brand with Confidence

Dashan helps you bring new packaging solutions to market faster—without sacrificing quality. Our
full-service OEM/ODM process allows you to co-develop innovative packaging lines tailored to your
product, branding, and regional compliance needs. Whether you need stock containers or fully
customized designs, our team ensures smooth execution from concept to container. With over 10 years
of export experience, we empower your growth across global food markets.

## Explore Our Full Range of Food Packaging Solutions

From takeaway drinks to ready-to-eat meals, we manufacture a comprehensive lineup of certified food
packaging products trusted by global food service brands. Choose from 6 core categories below—each
designed with performance, sustainability, and branding in mind.

Eco-friendly cornstarch tableware made from renewable materials, fully biodegradable, perfect for

## Markets

Hydropac serves a diverse range of industries, delivering temperature-controlled solutions tailored

every product is protected within its required temperature range, safeguarding integrity and
performance across all applications. See below to learn more about how we approach the sectors we

[ Custom solutions? ][131]

### Food Industry Assurance

From frozen goods to delicate confectioneries, our temperature-controlled packaging ensures that
taste, texture, and safety are preserved.

### Retail Innovation

Our products enhance the shelf life of perishable goods, from farm to table. We offer insulated
packaging that minimises temperature variations, preserving the freshness of food and produce.

### Pharmaceutical

Find solutions that preserve the efficacy and safety of medications, vaccines, and biologics. Our
solutions play a crucial role in maintaining the cold chain, ensuring that life-saving products
reach patients in optimal condition.

### Medical and Healthcare

We provide temperature-controlled solutions that contribute to the safe transportation of sensitive
medical equipment, samples, and products. From blood to diagnostic materials, our solutions maintain
the required temperature range.

### Promotional Markets

First impressions matter. Hydropac crafts custom-designed packaging solutions that elevate your
brand. Whether it's a branded ice pack or an innovative cooler, we help you make a lasting impact
while ensuring your products stay fresh and enticing.

your cargo; you’re contributing to a healthier world.

brand. Whether it's a branded ice pack or an innovative cooler, we help you make a lasting impact

JFC’s mission is to increase the distribution of foods from Japan and the rest of Asia. Building on
a century of success, JFC today is strategically poised for growth. Every day, we serve growing
numbers of Asian-American retail outlets, restaurants, and major North American retailers. And every
day, we deliver healthy, safe, high-quality Asian food products across the continent from our
strategically located distribution centers. Every day, in every way, JFC is moving to higher ground.

# Quality Merchandising
# & Good Service

# Product Catalog

[View All Products][10]
[[Sake Expert logo]][11]

From sake and soju to beer and premium spirits, JFC International has a strong connection with
international breweries and distilleries. We’re proud to share an extensive list of alcohol that we
distribute. Whether you’re a connoisseur or just starting your journey into sake, we invite you to
check our extensive list. Discover unique flavors, learn more about your favorite drinks, and
elevate your drinking experience through JFC’s Sake Expert.

[Visit Sake Expert][12]
[[Rice Expert logo]][13]

With approximately 480 million tons of rice being produced annually around the world, choosing the
right rice can be a challenge. JFC International has been part of the rice market for many years and
we understand that rice plays a vital role in countless meals. Whether you’re just learning about
rice or looking to experiment with different types of rice, JFC’s Rice Expert is here to help you
out. At JFC, we take our rice seriously.

[Visit Rice Expert][14]

## The hidden blackbox of frontline operations

### No transparency

Paper checklists make it impossible to see what’s happening across stores, shifts, or processes.
Companies lack clarity and accountability.

### Wasted time

Operations managers lose hours chasing missing reports across locations, fixing errors, and
consolidating data manually. Extra resources are needed just to keep operations running.

### Hidden risks

Inefficiencies, safety gaps, and quality issues remain unnoticed in daily routines. This leads to
high costs, compliance risks, and missed performance gains.

## How Lumiform solves it

### Digitize checklists and data collection

Turn paper inspections into digital workflows within minutes. No IT skills required. Field teams
complete checks easily on mobile (online or offline) while operations managers gain visibility
everywhere.

[Digitize checklists and data collection]

### Take corrective actions

When deviations occur, assign corrective actions instantly. Track progress seamlessly and restore
standards quickly, with full accountability and proof of resolution.

[Take corrective actions]

consolidate data across sites so operations leaders can track KPIs, spot inefficiencies, and drive
continuous improvements in safety, quality, and productivity.

# PAC by ProAmpac Packaging

## We’ve got some BIG news!

PAC Worldwide is now PAC by ProAmpac: Same Team. Same Products. Even More Possibilities.

[Learn More][91]

## What We Do

For 50 years, PAC has delivered high-performance protective packaging designed for businesses of all
sizes. From curbside recyclable paper mailers and bubble mailers to thermal packaging and industrial
bubble roll, we offer solutions that protect your products while prioritizing sustainability and
efficiency. Need custom packaging or void fill solutions to enhance protection? We’ve got you
covered. Whether you’re shipping perishables, e-commerce orders, or industrial goods, our flexible
food packaging, mailers, and automated systems ensure safe and efficient deliveries. Let’s create
the perfect packaging solution for your business.

## Custom and Stock Packaging Solutions

Our development team is constantly innovating toward new solutions for safe and exciting packaging
that helps our customers succeed.

## Automated Packaging Systems

PACjacket provides efficient, cost-effective and secure automated packaging to our customers with
higher volume packaging needs

## Exceptional Customer Support

The foundation of our company is all wrapped up in how we treat our customers. Our team is dedicated
to offering support and answering questions about our products.

## We’ve got some BIG news!

PAC Worldwide is now PAC by ProAmpac: Same Team. Same Products. Even More Possibilities.

[Learn More][91]

## What We Do

For 50 years, PAC has delivered high-performance protective packaging designed for businesses of all
sizes. From curbside recyclable paper mailers and bubble mailers to thermal packaging and industrial
bubble roll, we offer solutions that protect your products while prioritizing sustainability and
efficiency. Need custom packaging or void fill solutions to enhance protection? We’ve got you
covered. Whether you’re shipping perishables, e-commerce orders, or industrial goods, our flexible
food packaging, mailers, and automated systems ensure safe and efficient deliveries. Let’s create
the perfect packaging solution for your business.

Our development team is constantly innovating toward new solutions for safe and exciting packaging
that helps our customers succeed.

The foundation of our company is all wrapped up in how we treat our customers. Our team is dedicated

we are focusing on being an active and continuous member of the circular economy by keeping
packaging in the economy and out of the environment by designing for recycling, increasing recycled

**Well Established and Renowned- Quality Thermopack And Insulation Industries**

The faith and trust that our respective clients have shown in us are the biggest strength of our
organization. The confidence and support of our clients are the key factors of the recognition as
well as success, which we have achieved over the last 11 years. Owing to their positive support and
collaboration, we have reckoned as a well reputed business house at the global platform. Established
in the year **2001**, we are an eminent **Manufacturer and Supplier **of a comprehensive range of
**EPS Packaging and Insulation Material.** These light weight products are mostly used for packaging
purpose and also have the ability to withstand external temperatures as well as to keep the products
fresh & safe for a long period of time. Further, in order to attain absolute client satisfaction, we
serve our products as per specifications given by them as well as also provide flexible payment
options like cash, DD, cheque, NEFT, RTGS, and LC for the convenience of our wide spread clients.
Moreover, our quality, accuracy, honesty, timeliness, dedication, and variety have helped us to set
the benchmark not only in India but all across the international markets.

# Welcome to Sabert

Your trusted partner in sustainable and innovative food packaging solutions.

For more than 40 years, we've helped food distributors, restaurants, caterers, grocers, and national
chains deliver the food their customers love, with packaging that protects what's inside, performs
at the highest level, and meets you wherever you are on your sustainability journey.

*Engineered for what's next.* Our Centers for Innovation and an in-house product development team
push the boundaries of how food is packaged, protected, and served.

*Built across every substrate.* Advanced manufacturing across molded fiber, paper, and resin, backed
by 410+ active patents and a global footprint.

*Purpose that guides us.* Reinventing food packaging to nourish and protect our world.

# Welcome to Sabert

Your trusted partner in sustainable and innovative food packaging solutions.

For more than 40 years, we've helped food distributors, restaurants, caterers, grocers, and national
chains deliver the food their customers love, with packaging that protects what's inside, performs
at the highest level, and meets you wherever you are on your sustainability journey.

*Engineered for what's next.* Our Centers for Innovation and an in-house product development team
push the boundaries of how food is packaged, protected, and served.

*Built across every substrate.* Advanced manufacturing across molded fiber, paper, and resin, backed
by 410+ active patents and a global footprint.

*Purpose that guides us.* Reinventing food packaging to nourish and protect our world.

### **What is Gadget Flow?**

Gadget Flow is the original product discovery platform that keeps you up to date with the latest
[tech][226], gear, and most incredible crowdfunding campaigns. Reaching over 31 million people per
month, we also have iOS and Android apps that support AR and VR for next-level product exploration.

#### Why Use Gadget Flow?

We keep you updated with the latest tech product announcements for everything from the newest
[drones][227] to obscure [gaming gadgets][228]. Our team discovers unique products and covers the
latest crowdfunding campaigns. Save gadgets to your private or public wish lists, check out our
team’s expert reviews, and purchase products directly from trusted sellers.

#### [Meet the Team][229]

Gadget Flow is headquartered in New York City, and most of our team works remotely from the US and
Europe. We are tech enthusiasts who love to learn about new technologies and the latest innovations.
Talented individuals who are passionate about the future, we work tirelessly and love to excite you
and teach you about advancements in our field.

### Join Gadget Flow Today

Explore the world of Gadget Flow so you know when any new tech launches—anywhere. Create your
account using your email or any of our supported third-party logins, such as Google, Apple, and
Facebook.
1

Sign up to create private and public wish lists that you can share with family and friends. It’s
also easy to organize your favorite gadgets into different collections, like gift guides, smart home
products you love, and more.
2

#### Get Product Notifications

What do you do when you find a product that you love but aren’t ready to buy? Simply create a
notification! Click the three little dots by the buy now button and select Add Reminder to get
notified. Receive a reminder when it’s discounted, Black Friday, the next season, or any date you
choose.
3

#### Discover with Watch

Now you can discover new products through our video feed. With Gadget Flow Watch, browse through
your favorite categories and create playlists. Our endless selection of videos will have you
discovering gadgets for hours.

TradeAtlas’ global database provides the most up-to-date information about overseas importers and
exporters for companies aiming to make trade connections in international markets and monitor their
customers & competitors. The importers’ and exporters’ data on TradeAtlas is obtained from bill of
lading data and customs records. Therefore, all the information on the database comes from actual
and realized transactions.

[MORE INFORMATION >>][41]

With the Potential Importers solution, you can discover the companies that have not imported a
product or product group in the target market you have selected but have a very high potential to
import in a matter of seconds with nearly 100% accuracy. We provide the most suitable importer and
supplier companies for your export among millions of real companies via “Top-Matching Importers
Module” which is listed by evaluating many parameters such as import volumes, past import
transactions, geographical distance, import frequencies, interest levels and trade sizes.

[MORE INFORMATION >>][42]

TradeAtlas works closely with producers to promote their products internationally. We offer a
state-of-art marketing strategy powered by our own company-level data, which includes 20+ million
importers all over the world from 230 countries/territories, from USA to Papua New Guinea, from
Madagascar to Chile, from Yemen to the UK. We contact, negotiate and close sales for your products
on behalf of your company with our experienced team and dealers all over the world. Please contact
us for more details, including your products and website for a preliminary analysis.

[CONTACT US >>][43]

TradeAtlas features can be used through our simple REST API. Integrate with TradeAtlas API to
automatize your work with company-level international trade data. TradeAtlas API does 2 main jobs:
count feature (you can count how many Italian exporters are there who exports furniture to the USA)
and download feature (you can download all details of the Italian exporters who exports furniture to
the USA, including importer and exporter company names, prices, quantities, products, HS codes,
ports, and more, whichever available in our database). Please feel free to contact us for more
details, pricing, technical documents and a free trial.

[MORE INFORMATION >>][44]

TradeAtlas’ unique coverage of company-level international trade data, consists of 2+ billion lines
of transactions, could also be ordered via reporting feature (offline Excel/CSV files). Please
describe your need for trade route (for ex; I need shipments arriving to African continent from
EU-27 zone / or / all shipments leaving Chile to the world), product (for ex; I need all drug
shipments / or / I need all shipments under Chapter 70: Glass and glassware) and the period for the

transactions, geographical distance, import frequencies, interest levels and trade sizes.

state-of-art marketing strategy powered by our own company-level data, which includes 20+ million
importers all over the world from 230 countries/territories, from USA to Papua New Guinea, from

on behalf of your company with our experienced team and dealers all over the world. Please contact
us for more details, including your products and website for a preliminary analysis.

## Welcome aboard

Discover how airports are achieving zero waste, a critical first step towards circularity. Explore
our database of initiatives and join us in sharing best practices for a sustainable aviation
industry. Let’s collaborate to achieve a global circular economy. 

### Zero Waste Airports

Airports, bustling hubs of global connectivity, generate vast amounts of waste. By reimagining waste
as a resource, airports can forge new economic pathways, minimize waste, and lessen reliance on
virgin materials. Achieving zero waste is no easy task. Supported by a baseline assessment, the
focus is on addressing key streams: plastic, paper, food, and residual waste. The initiatives
proposed in the database emphasize prevention and reuse to minimize environmental impact, with
recycling considered as a last resort.

### From zero waste to circular airports

Are you intrigued by the prospect of eliminating waste through proactive prevention and reuse
strategies, while also maximizing the value of resources? Explore how TULIPS WP Circular Airports,
encompasses collaboration among various partners in charting the course for a circular future.

[ More Info ][32]

### Database

Explore the database of zero waste initiatives covering residual, paper, plastic, and food streams.
Browse ideas for prevention, reuse, or recycling, and even contribute your own innovative solutions

[ More Info ][33]

### Resources

Discover the resources and tools designed to help airports kickstart their journey towards
circularity today. From protocols for baseline assessment to monitoring frameworks aimed at
achieving circularity by 2050, these practical solutions can make a difference

[ More Info ][34]

### Connecting for a Circular Future in Aviation

Join us in accelerating the global circular economy transition. Have initiatives to share or
questions to ask? Feel free to reach out to us.
